human_interaction.description: How Guild addresses the human, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md sections 3.1 and 11.3.

address_profiles_by.description: Which of a profile's two names human-facing messages lead with.

approval_request_required_fields.description: Fields a Red-tier approval request must state before a human answers it.

decision_request_required_fields.description: Fields a decision request must state before a human is asked to answer it.

answer_options.description: How anything left for a person to resolve may be answered. Every question Guild puts to a human is enumerated and always carries a free-text option, so an answer the asking profile did not think of is still an answer rather than silence. See GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 11.3.

always_enumerated.description: A question reaches a person as listed options, never as open prose.

always_offer_free_text.description: The listed options are never the only way to answer.

free_text_option_key.description: The key under which an answer in the human's own words is offered.

free_text_is_recorded_verbatim.description: A free-text answer is recorded as given, never mapped onto the nearest listed option.

free_text_never_counts_as_approval.description: On a Red-tier approval only an explicit approval approves; free text is recorded and leaves the action blocked.

approval_request_answers.description: The answers a Red-tier approval request offers, including the free-text key.

decision_request_answers.description: The answers a decision request offers, including 'defer' and the free-text key.

knowledge_protocol.description: How ownership and knowledge are distributed across profiles, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 7.

ownership_map.description: Path to the orchestrator's routing index of areas, owners and ledger locations.

profile_ledger.description: Path pattern of a single profile's own knowledge ledger.

ownership_map_maintained_by.description: Canonical profile id allowed to write the ownership map.

canonical_memory_consolidated_by.description: Canonical profile id allowed to consolidate canonical memory.

decision_protocol.description: How a decision no profile can make from the project itself reaches a person and is closed, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 11.2.

decision_records.description: Directory holding the decision records answers produce.

presented_by.description: Canonical profile id that puts a decision request in front of the human.

found_work_protocol.description: How a change a profile finds while doing something else, which it is not going to make now and which blocks nothing, becomes a technical-debt work item in the plan instead of a note, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 8.1.

plan_file.description: Plan file found work is appended to as a work item.

status_field.description: Field of the project status listing open technical-debt items by id.

item_kind.description: The task kind found work is recorded as.

id_series.description: Id prefix of the found-work series, e.g. TD.

recorded_by.description: Who may record found work. Any profile may: the one that found it is the one that knows the evidence.

assigned_to.description: Who a found item is assigned to — the owner of the area it was found in, so found work never lands on a communal pile.

scheduled_by.description: Canonical profile id allowed to schedule found work into a milestone. Recording is open to every profile; prioritizing is not.

language_protocol.description: Which human languages Guild uses in a project — conversation, state prose and git — and how the human chooses them, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 3.2.

settings_file.description: State file the chosen languages are recorded in.

settings_field.description: Field of the settings file that holds them.

settings.description: The three language settings; each is asked separately.

asked_by.description: Canonical profile id that asks for the languages and records them.

chosen_by.description: Only the human chooses a language; no profile infers one.

asked_in_steps.description: Workflow step ids that ask for the languages before any other question.

pull_request_review_automation_protocol.description: How the human chooses whether the Barbarian and/or the Rogue run automatically on every pull request, and what that automation may and may not do, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 11.4.

settings_file.description: State file the choice is recorded in.

settings_field.description: Field of the settings file that holds it.

eligible_profiles.description: Profiles that may run automatically on pull requests.

mode.description: The automation only comments; it never stands in for a gate.

asked_by.description: Canonical profile id that asks and records the choice.

chosen_by.description: Only the human chooses whether the automation runs.

asked_in_steps.description: Workflow step ids that ask for the choice.

set_up_by.description: Canonical profile id that writes the CI job.

set_up_skill.description: Skill id the CI job is written with.

reviewed_by.description: Canonical profile id that reviews the CI job before it is enabled.

approvals_required.description: Red-tier policy keys the human approves before the job is enabled.

onboarding_protocol.description: What happens when Guild is used in a project that has not been onboarded, per GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 9.1.

onboarded_when_exists.description: The file whose existence means the project has been onboarded.

asked_by.description: Canonical profile id that offers onboarding.

asked_in_skill.description: Skill id in which the question is asked.

onboarding_workflows.description: Workflow ids that onboard a project.
